name: AR_STATEMENT_LINE_CLUSTERS
description:
The AR_STATEMENT_LINE_CLUSTERS table is an interim table that is used in statement generation and contains a row for every line that appears on a statement. The LINE_CLUSTER_ID column groups rows and represents the set of lines that appear on one statement.
.
The primary keys for this table are LINE_CLUSTER_ID, CUSTOMER_TRX_SEQUENCE, PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_SEQUENCE, TRX_ORDER_SEQUENCE, and GENERAL_SEQUENCE.

columns.name: LINE_CLUSTER_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the line cluster

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Foreign key reference to  RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL table.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Payment schedule ID of the INVOICE_NUMBER which serves as a foreign key to the AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES table

columns.name: TRX_ORDER_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Specifies the ordering of statement lines

columns.name: GENERAL_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Unique identifier from the AR_STATEMENT_LINE_CLUSTERS_S sequence

columns.name: INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: The date of the transaction

columns.name: TRANSACTION
columns.description: Transaction description

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date of the transaction

columns.name: REFERENCE
columns.description: Refers to any receipt or credit memo related to the statement line. It stores the receipt or credit memo number.

columns.name: BILL_TO_LOCATION
columns.description: Address of the bill to location

columns.name: TRX_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount of the transaction

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE
columns.description: The amount due

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Adjustment identifier. Foreign key to the AR_ADJUSTMENTS table.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer identifier. Foreign key to the RA_CUSTOMERS table.

columns.name: RECEIVABLE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier. Foreign key to the AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS table.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Site use identifier of the transaction. Foreign key to the RA_SITE_USES_ALL table.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CITY
columns.description: City of the customer bill to address.

columns.name: ORIG_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Original payment amount

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CODE
columns.description: Transaction class. CB, CM, DM, INV, or PMT

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the receipt being applied to the invoice

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPLIED_FROM
columns.description: Amount applied in the receipt currency

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
